title: Teamtailor Jobs API input
description: Give one or more Teamtailor boards: a company name, a host or a full URL.

boards.title: Boards
boards.description: Teamtailor boards to read, one per item: a company name like oatly, a host like oatly.teamtailor.com, a self-hosted board like jobs.tibber.com, or a full URL. An address with no board gets a free NOT_CHECKED_BOARD_NOT_FOUND row instead of a silent empty run.

includeDetails.title: Include descriptions
includeDetails.description: Include the full description of every role. On by default: on a live board that is the whole text of the posting, already inside the same answer, so no extra request is made per role.

descriptionFormat.title: Description format
descriptionFormat.description: html keeps the employer markup, text strips the tags and keeps the line breaks.

maxJobsPerBoard.title: Max roles per board
maxJobsPerBoard.description: How many matching roles to process per board. 0 means no limit. Roles past the limit are counted in the summary and never charged.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Comma separated phrases; a role matches when any phrase occurs in its title or company. Example: engineer, data. Empty means no keyword filter.

employmentType.title: Employment type contains
employmentType.description: Keep only roles whose employment type contains this text, for example FULL_TIME. The feed writes full time and part time roles in upper case.

city.title: City contains
city.description: Keep only roles with at least one office in this city. Every office of a multi-location role is checked, not only the first one.

country.title: Country
country.description: Keep only roles in this country: a two letter code like NL is compared for equality, a longer name like Netherlands is matched against the country name. Both are checked across every office of the role.

remoteOnly.title: Remote only
remoteOnly.description: Keep only roles the employer marked as remote. The feed says so itself through jobLocationType TELECOMMUTE or applicant location requirements, so this is a fact and not a guess from the word remote in the title.

publishedAfter.title: Published after
publishedAfter.description: Keep only roles published after this date, ISO form like 2026-10-01. Empty means no date filter.

requestTimeoutSecs.title: Request timeout, seconds
requestTimeoutSecs.description: How long one board may take before it is reported as unreadable. A large board answers in about a second, so the default is generous.
